description: A walled tank 5 deep (water x 2 to 14), with a soul sand bubble column at x = 2 and a magma one at x = 6, both up to the surface: jump off the west wall into the up column's edge; drop into the middle of the up column from 3 blocks above it and bob over it; drop into the down column and get dragged to the bottom; sprint-swim east along the bottom, swim up, dive, swim up to the surface; sprint-swim west back through both columns (dragged down, then pushed up against the wall); hold jump in the up column.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
